edits.old: SCR-03 Case record: the empty, error and no access states are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-295); its other states come from Screen Specifications v1 section SCR-03. edits.new:
Every call is one hop to the owning service, or to gateway-bff, on its own base (DP-11, DP-13, DP-19) with the 2 s client budget; the suite calls no service through another service.

**Contract version.** The suite builds against API Specification v5, version 5.0.0 of the rwb-document and rwb-case contracts (`rwb-document.yaml`, `rwb-case.yaml` and, for events, `asyncapi/rwb-document.asyncapi.yaml`). The version of the gateway-bff composite route for SCR-30 is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E1026-ITG-23), because the route is not published (GAP-0351; ASM-0445).
